title: Beat or rhythm?
how: Play any piece (or listen to one). Tap your foot on the beat and clap the rhythm of the tune. Then swap: clap the beat, tap the rhythm.

title: Slow to fast
how: Number the metronome marks from the slowest (1) to the fastest (4).

title: Strong beats
how: Each dot is one beat. Circle the strong beat in every bar; in 4/4, also underline the medium beat.
answer: beat 1 of every bar; in 4/4 also beat 3

title: Two, three or four?
how: Someone plays a piece, or a march, a waltz and a song online. Count along and decide how many beats are in each bar.

title: Tempo ladder
how: Clap the line while counting aloud. Tick a step each time it is steady, then move the metronome up.

title: Walk the beat
how: Set the metronome to ♩ = 80. Walk one step on every beat, saying the counts. Stop on beat 1 when someone says “freeze”.

title: Count it
how: Write a count in every box. Count the rests too: they are beats of silence.

title: Clap and open
how: Clap on every crotchet; open your hands wide on every rest. Count aloud.

title: Which did you hear?
how: Someone claps one rhythm from the row. Circle A, B or C. Then swap roles.

title: Finish with rests
how: Each bar is short. Complete it with crotchet rests (draw as many as you need).

title: Rhythm echo
how: Someone claps one bar of crotchets and rests; you clap it straight back without a pause. Colour a square for every echo that is exactly right.

title: Rest patterns
how: Make four different bars of 4/4 using crotchets and crotchet rests. No two the same. Clap each one.

title: Two hands
how: Right hand plays the top line on one key, left hand the bottom line on another. Slowly, then faster.

title: Count it
how: Write a count in every box: the beat you play, then the beats you hold.

title: Balance the scales
how: Write one note on the right so both sides last the same.

title: Rhythm dominoes
how: Use the cards to fill one bar of 4/4 exactly (4 beats). How many different ways can you find? Write each way by drawing the notes.
answer: e.g. semibreve · two minims · minim + two crotchets · four crotchets · minim + crotchet + crotchet rest …

title: Full bar hunt
how: Colour every box that holds exactly four beats.

title: Rhythm detective
how: Each line has one bar with the wrong number of beats. Circle it and fix it.
answer: line 1: bar 2 (5 beats) · line 2: bar 3 (3 beats)

title: Short or long?
how: Someone claps one rhythm from the row. Circle A, B or C.

title: Question and answer
how: The first two bars ask a question. Write two bars that answer it, ending on a long note. Play it on one key.

title: In your music
how: Find these in a piece you are learning.

title: Clap and count
how: Clap and count each line, holding your hands together through the long notes.
